raw_response:
This season I plan to put my effort into this maize plot because it is what feeds my family. I received a FISP coupon again this year, so I will use the subsidized NPK and urea on this plot first before spreading any leftover to my other fields. I will also carry some manure from the goats and plant hybrid seed from the coupon — the local seed I kept does not yield as well. My wife and I will do most of the ridging and weeding ourselves; I may call one or two people for ganyu during the first weeding if the rains come hard.
